name: WorldOracle: Benchmarking Action-Conditioned World Models against Real-World Executions

validation_dataset_access.official_github_readme: Announces validation release on 2026-10-15 and documents an AgiBot G2 subset.
validation_dataset_access.current_huggingface_card: Labels the validation dataset private as observed on 2026-10-31.
validation_dataset_access.required_resolution: Obtain explicit authorized access and reconcile the official GitHub release announcement with current Hugging Face visibility before any data download or use.
validation_dataset_access.policy: Do not download, mirror, train on, redistribute, or claim to have locally evaluated this dataset until access is explicitly authorized. The Apache-2.0 code license does not grant data rights.

test_input_access.policy: Do not access or mirror. Hidden test ground truth remains withheld and official-service evaluated.

release.access_discrepancy_note: The official GitHub README describes a public validation release, while the current Hugging Face card labels the dataset private. Treat current effective access as unresolved/restricted; require authorized resolution before use.

evaluation_contract.input_conditioning: Same initial observation and low-level action trajectory; predicted rollout is compared with its paired real-world execution.
evaluation_contract.aggregation: Within-task episode averaging, followed by equal weighting across tasks.
evaluation_contract.comparability_rule: Do not mix paper and live leaderboard scores without matching the evaluator version and all metric settings.

reproduction_constraints.validation_claim_ceiling: Official public-validation reference, smaller and less diverse than the hidden test set; expect high variance.
reproduction_constraints.data_use: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 is non-commercial/share-alike. Do not infer commercial training rights from the Apache-2.0 source-code license.
reproduction_constraints.resource_requirements: Linux/Python 3.10; CUDA recommended for V-JEPA2, LPIPS and DINOv3. Public AgiBot G2 validation GT is approximately 18.6 GiB, excluding inference files, predictions and checkpoints.
reproduction_constraints.physical_judge_cost: Evaluation uses an OpenAI-compatible VLM endpoint. Pin endpoint/model version and account for inference cost.
reproduction_constraints.no_test_leakage: Do not use withheld test ground truth; use the official portal for test evaluation.
reproduction_constraints.source_and_data_pinning: Before a run, pin exact source, dataset commit, validation manifest, SHA-256 archives, evaluator checkpoints, VLM version, Python/CUDA dependency lock and local configuration.

claim_ceiling: Published validation scores are reference targets, not our measurements. No Symthaea result, matched comparison or SOTA claim exists yet.
published_validation_scores_note: The official validation results file is indicative only; the authors warn that the validation set is substantially smaller and less diverse than the test set. It reports scores for selected platforms/tracks, not a complete table over all 67 validation episodes.
